selection.basis: Q00010/C112 independently accepted B00092 exact Release 32bpp extraction evidence. These four even assets have 37 accepted scopes / 38 physical semantic occurrences and no newer B producer result for the same assets.

material_advance.description: Converts C112-accepted B00092 exact Release 32bpp extraction scopes into first-pass-v2 header-gated source-effect-mask/CLEAN_PLATE execution units. No channel interpretation, source-effect bbox, mask, clean plate, candidate-safe bbox or Korean pixels are guessed.

reused_immutable_evidence.reason: C112 independently rechecked 4/4 source size equations, 37/37 raw-coordinate/row-slice/file/canvas formulas, zero overlap and 38/38 physical semantics. P00034 only adds the next v2 header-gated source-mask/CLEAN_PLATE execution contract.

conclusion: P00034 advances four C112-consumed even-shard unfinished assets into 37 deterministic header-gated first-pass-v2 source-effect-mask/CLEAN_PLATE work units covering 38 physical semantic occurrences. Every work unit has a nonempty 2px cell guard and accepted payload scope; the BF229CF4 START/GOAL shared cell explicitly requires independent masks. Exact DDS header/channel interpretation and all downstream decoded-pixel/candidate gates remain fail-closed; runtime remains UNTESTED.
